scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.test:web: npm run lint -w apps/web && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=/api NEXT_OUTPUT_STANDALONE=false NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:types:api && npm run test:web
